attributes.title: cc-decisions
attributes.name: Decisions (cc-decisions)
attributes.runtimeFieldMap: {"isApproved": {"type": "long", "script": {"source": "emit(doc['payload.outcome'].size() > 0 && doc['payload.outcome'].value == 'APPROVE' ? 1 : 0)"}}, "isDeclined": {"type": "long", "script": {"source": "emit(doc['payload.outcome'].size() > 0 && doc['payload.outcome'].value == 'DECLINE' ? 1 : 0)"}}, "isReferred": {"type": "long", "script": {"source": "emit(doc['payload.outcome'].size() > 0 && doc['payload.outcome'].value == 'REFER' ? 1 : 0)"}}, "scoreBand": {"type": "keyword", "script": {"source": "if (doc['payload.applicantSummary.bureauScore'].size() == 0) return; long lo = (doc['payload.applicantSummary.bureauScore'].value / 25) * 25; emit(lo + '-' + (lo + 24));"}}, "limitBand": {"type": "keyword", "script": {"source": "if (doc['payload.creditLimit'].size() == 0 || doc['payload.creditLimit'].value <= 0) return; long lo = ((long) (doc['payload.creditLimit'].value / 2500)) * 2500; String a = Long.toString(lo); while (a.length() < 5) { a = '0' + a; } String b = Long.toString(lo + 2499); while (b.length() < 5) { b = '0' + b; } emit(a + '-' + b);"}}, "tdsBand": {"type": "keyword", "script": {"source": "if (doc['payload.applicantSummary.tdsRatio'].size() == 0) return; long k = (long) (doc['payload.applicantSummary.tdsRatio'].value * 20); if (k >= 20) { emit('100%+'); return; } long lo = k * 5; String a = Long.toString(lo); if (a.length() < 2) { a = '0' + a; } String b = Long.toString(lo + 5); if (b.length() < 2) { b = '0' + b; } emit(a + '-' + b + '%');"}}}

attributes.title: Applications today
attributes.description: Automated (ODM) decisions since midnight; one per application that reached the rules.

attributes.title: Approval rate
attributes.description: Approved divided by all automated decisions in the selected period.

attributes.title: Referral rate
attributes.description: Share of automated decisions that went to an underwriter (REFER).

attributes.title: Decline rate
attributes.description: Share of automated decisions that were declined.

attributes.title: Average credit limit
attributes.description: Average limit of approved applications (CAD).

attributes.title: Manual decisions
attributes.description: Decisions taken by an underwriter on a referral (decisionSource MANUAL).

attributes.title: Decisions over time
attributes.description: Automated decisions per interval by outcome (approve green, decline red, refer amber).

attributes.title: Approval rate over time
attributes.description: Approved divided by all automated decisions, per interval.

attributes.title: Decisions by province
attributes.description: Automated decisions per province by outcome.

attributes.title: Approved applications by product
attributes.description: Products are assigned on approval only.

attributes.title: Decisions by age band
attributes.description: Automated decisions per applicant age band (derived by Logstash, never the date of birth).

attributes.title: Credit limit distribution
attributes.description: Approved credit limits (CAD) in buckets.

attributes.title: Bureau score distribution
attributes.description: Applications per bureau score bucket by outcome.

attributes.title: TDS ratio vs outcome
attributes.description: How many decisions fall into each total debt service ratio bucket, per outcome.

attributes.title: Credit Decisioning - Executive
attributes.description: Volumes, approval, referral and decline rates, limits and score profile of the credit card decisions. Fictitious bank, synthetic data.

attributes.title: Decline reasons (top 10)
attributes.description: Reason codes of automated declines; one decline can carry several codes.

attributes.title: Decline reason trend
attributes.description: The five most frequent decline reasons over time.

attributes.title: Approval parity by province
attributes.description: Approval rate of each province, its sample size (n) and the disparate impact ratio: group rate divided by the overall rate. Below 0.8 (four-fifths rule) deserves a look; small n gives noisy ratios.

attributes.title: Approval parity by age band
attributes.description: Same as by province, per applicant age band. Below 0.8 deserves a look; read it with n.

attributes.title: Decisions by ruleset version
attributes.description: Which version of the ODM ruleset produced the automated decisions.

attributes.title: ODM vs MANUAL decisions
attributes.description: Automated (ODM) decisions and underwriter (MANUAL) decisions over time.

attributes.title: Underwriter decisions on referrals
attributes.description: Manual decisions per underwriter and final outcome (each answers a REFER from the rules).

attributes.title: Credit Decisioning - Risk & Fairness
attributes.description: Why applications are declined, whether approval is even across provinces and age bands, which ruleset decided, and what underwriters changed.
